job.job_description:
Work on frontier Generative AI systems used at massive global scale
Hands-on prompt engineering across Gemini and other frontier LLMs
High-impact role driving 95%+ alignment with human reviewer performance
Collaborative, experimentation-driven environment with client calibration
Hyderabad-based role with clear technical growth pathways
Hands-on experience with Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic APIs
Strong expertise in Prompt Engineering (few-shot, system prompts, structured outputs, context management)
Strong Python development skills (not notebook-only usage), with hands-on prompt engineering design, deployment, and debugging
Experience debugging, testing, and improving LLM applications
Strong analytical thinking and an experimental mindset
Ability to write clear technical documentation and RCA reports
Comfort working in ambiguous, evaluation-driven environments
5 to 5+ years of experience; based in Hyderabad
Good to have: Agentic AI, ReAct, and Chain-of-Thought prompting
Good to have: RAG systems and evaluation datasets
Good to have: LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex
Good to have: REST APIs, Postman, and JSON
Good to have: Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or Ad evaluation experience
Tune and test Gemini and LLM-based systems in production workflows
Analyze overnight evaluation outputs and identify model failures
Classify issues such as hallucinations, context misses, and boundary errors
Design and iterate prompts using hypothesis-driven experimentation
Improve prompts using few-shot examples, constraints, and RAG updates
Run regression testing using golden datasets before deployment
Deploy prompt changes and monitor system performance
Write RCA reports and hypothesis documentation, and participate in client calibration sessions
Work with agentic AI and tool-calling workflows


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
